title: Electronics Diagram
description: The JSON notation an LLM creates/edits via MCP tools. Layout (component placement and wire routing) is computed automatically from this structure, so it intentionally has no position/canvas fields.

id.description: UUID for this diagram. Must match the diagramId used in MCP tool calls and the /view/{id} page.

title.description: Optional human-readable name for the diagram.

regions.description: Optional named groups (e.g. a physical device vs. a virtual/cloud service). Components join one via their 'region' field; each region is drawn as a labelled box around its components.

id.description: Unique identifier for this region within the diagram, e.g. 'device'. Referenced by components' 'region' field.

label.description: Display title drawn on the region's box, e.g. 'Physical device'.

kind.description: Styling hint: 'physical' (default) draws a solid border, 'virtual' a dashed one.

description.description: Optional free-text notes about what this region represents.

id.description: Unique identifier for this component instance within the diagram, e.g. 'esp32-1'. Referenced by connections.

type.description: Component type key. Must match the 'type' of a definition in data/components/*.json (discoverable via the list_component_types MCP tool), e.g. 'esp32', 'nodemcu', 'hall_sensor'.

label.description: Optional display label override, e.g. 'X-axis endstop'.

region.description: Optional id of a region (see top-level 'regions') this component belongs to.

definition.description: Defines a brand-new component type on the fly, scoped to this diagram only. Required when 'type' isn't one of the types returned by list_component_types. Mirrors schema/component-definition.schema.json, minus 'type' (supplied by this component's own 'type' field above).

component.description: References a component's 'id' field in this diagram.

pin.description: Pin name. Must match one of the pins defined for that component instance's type.
